title: GTA VI: the 13-year wait, in one timeline
description: GTA VI finally launched in November 2026, thirteen years after GTA V. Here is the timeline of the delays and the launch.

scenes.say: GTA Six finally launched, thirteen years after GTA Five. That is a very long wait for fans, so here is the road it took, step by step.
Rockstar first aimed for 2025. Then it moved the game to May twenty sixth, 2026. Then it slipped again, to November nineteenth. Rockstar apologised for the extra wait.

scenes.caption: Grand Theft Auto VI
scenes.say: It arrived on November nineteenth, built by Rockstar Games. Press reports put the estimated cost at more than one billion dollars.
On launch day, it opened with a Metacritic score of ninety nine, from more than a hundred and fifty critic reviews.
Two console generations later, the series is back on the shelves. Follow for more gaming stories, explained fast.
